description: Reach Ynysdail with 73 Sailing and Song of the Elves completed. Build this facility with 50 Construction, a hammer, a saw, and 8 camphor planks and 10 swamp paste.

name: Museum Camp — fossil cleaning station

name: Museum Camp — well

name: Museum Camp — cooking pot

name: Museum Camp — spinning wheel

name: Museum Camp — loom
description: After Bone Voyage, build this facility with 29 Construction, a hammer, and 2 oak planks, 5 nails and a rope.

name: Zamorak’s Fortress — permanent light
description: Consume Saradomin’s light from Commander Zilyana to remove the darkness effect in Zamorak’s Fortress.

name: Teleport anchoring
description: Read a teleport anchoring scroll to gain permanent protection against the teleport attacks of elder chaos druids and abyssal demons.

name: Camdozaal — fishing
description: After Below Ice Mountain, spend 2,500 barronite shards at Ramarno’s exchange for the permanent local upgrade: 10% better fish-catching chance.

name: Camdozaal — fish preparation
description: After Below Ice Mountain, spend 2,500 barronite shards at Ramarno’s exchange for the permanent local upgrade: 10% better fish-preparation chance.

name: Camdozaal — defence
description: After Below Ice Mountain, spend 2,500 barronite shards at Ramarno’s exchange for the permanent local upgrade: a five-level Defence benefit against golems.

name: Camdozaal — mining
description: After Below Ice Mountain, spend 2,500 barronite shards at Ramarno’s exchange for the permanent local upgrade: 10% better barronite mining chance.

name: Camdozaal — rare finds
description: After Below Ice Mountain, spend 3,000 barronite shards at Ramarno’s exchange for the permanent local upgrade: 5% better rare-item find chance.

name: Permanent fire — Mole Hole
description: After Making Friends with My Arm, use 35 Construction and 66 Firemaking to build and light the pit for an everlasting light source. Bring 2 mahogany planks, 2 steel bars, 300 te, 100 efh and 50 urt salts, a hammer, saw and tinderbox.

name: Permanent fire — Lumbridge Swamp Caves
description: After Making Friends with My Arm, use 35 Construction and 66 Firemaking to build and light the pit for light and removal of swamp gas. Bring 2 mahogany planks, 2 steel bars, 300 te, 100 efh and 50 urt salts, a hammer, saw and tinderbox.

name: Permanent fire — Mos Le'Harmless Cave
description: After Making Friends with My Arm, use 35 Construction and 66 Firemaking to build and light the pit for an everlasting light source. Bring 2 mahogany planks, 2 steel bars, 300 te, 100 efh and 50 urt salts, a hammer, saw and tinderbox.

name: Permanent fire — Weiss
description: After Making Friends with My Arm, use 35 Construction and 66 Firemaking to build and light the pit for access to the disease-free herb patch. Bring 2 mahogany planks, 2 steel bars, 50 te, 100 efh and 150 urt salts, a hammer, saw and tinderbox.

name: Permanent fire — Mort Myre Swamp
description: After Making Friends with My Arm, use 50 Construction and 66 Firemaking to build and light the pit for protection from swamp decay and ghasts. Bring 2 mahogany planks, 2 steel bars, 50 te, 300 efh and 100 urt salts, a hammer, saw and tinderbox. Nature Spirit is also required.

name: Permanent fire — God Wars Dungeon
description: After Making Friends with My Arm, use 60 Construction and 66 Firemaking to build and light the pit for protection from the approach’s stat drain. Bring 2 mahogany planks, 2 steel bars, 100 te, 50 efh and 300 urt salts, a hammer, saw and tinderbox.

name: Castle Wars — accumulator effect

name: Ranging cape assembler effect
description: Apply a Vorkath’s head to a Ranging cape or Max cape. The upgrade then applies to all applicable capes.

description: Take Dizana’s quiver and Ava’s attractor to Ava for the corresponding ammunition-saving upgrade. Higher upgrades replace lower effects.

name: Dizana’s quiver — assembler effect

name: Crystal re-enchantment discount — tier 1
description: Have a crystal weapon seed re-enchanted 1 times. The fourth discount reaches 180,000 GP for a bow or 150,000 GP for a shield or halberd.

name: Crystal re-enchantment discount — tier 2
description: Have a crystal weapon seed re-enchanted 2 times. The fourth discount reaches 180,000 GP for a bow or 150,000 GP for a shield or halberd.

name: Crystal re-enchantment discount — tier 3

name: Crystal re-enchantment discount — tier 4
description: Have a crystal weapon seed re-enchanted 4 times. The fourth discount reaches 180,000 GP for a bow or 150,000 GP for a shield or halberd.

name: Mystic cards
description: Ask Diango to redeem the public promotional code v1r354cqu1r173und0, then collect the cards.

name: Slayer helmet shaman protection
description: Complete the hard Kourend & Kebos Diary, obtain a Shayzien helm (5), then speak to Captain Cleive to extend its protection to your Slayer helmet.

name: PvP loot keys
description: Pay Skully 1,000,000 GP at Ferox Enclave to unlock loot keys. Unlocking and switching key collection on are separate choices.

name: Hallowed Sepulchre — private instances
description: Spend 200 Hallowed marks to unlock the option to enter a private instance.

name: Artio lair — peek
description: Record 20 Artio kills to unlock peeking into Hunter's End. Lair entry still has its own Wilderness diary or qualifying boss-task requirement.

name: Callisto lair — peek
description: Record 20 Callisto kills to unlock peeking into Callisto's Den. Lair entry still has its own Wilderness diary or qualifying boss-task requirement.

name: Spindel lair — peek

name: Venenatis lair — peek

name: Calvar'ion lair — peek

name: Vet'ion lair — peek
description: Record 20 Vet'ion kills to unlock peeking into Vet'ion's Rest. Lair entry still has its own Wilderness diary or qualifying boss-task requirement.

name: Rogue Trader — runes

name: Rogue Trader — clothing
description: After The Feud, complete the clothing branch of Rogue Trader to expand Ali Morrisane’s stock. Quest completion alone does not finish this branch.

name: Jatizso yak-produce shop
description: Give Vanligga Gastfrihet 5,000 GP to gain access to her shop in Jatizso.

name: Uglug's shop
description: After Zogre Flesh Eaters, sell Uglug Nar a dose of relicym’s balm to open his stock.

name: Guardians of the Rift — pouch repair
description: Pay Apprentice Cordelia 25 abyssal pearls to unlock her essence-pouch repair service.

name: Permanent falconry access
description: Pay Matthias 500,000 GP for unlimited gyr falcon use instead of the normal 500 GP hire fee.

name: Isles — cannonball-bar exchange
description: Visit Grimstone with 87 Sailing, then speak to Isles at Port Roberts to unlock the service in Grimstone Dungeon. Unnoting eligible metal bars costs 100 GP per bar.

name: Camelot respawn unlock
description: Complete Knight Waves Training Grounds to unlock Camelot as an available respawn option. This check does not mean it is your currently selected respawn.

name: Falador respawn unlock
description: Complete Recruitment Drive to unlock Falador as an available respawn option. This check does not mean it is your currently selected respawn.

name: Prifddinas respawn unlock
description: Complete Song Of The Elves to unlock Prifddinas as an available respawn option. This check does not mean it is your currently selected respawn.

name: Kourend Castle respawn unlock
description: Complete A Kingdom Divided to unlock Kourend Castle as an available respawn option. This check does not mean it is your currently selected respawn.

name: Edgeville respawn purchase
description: Pay Krystilia 5,000,000 GP to unlock this respawn option permanently. Selecting it as your current respawn is separate.

name: Ferox Enclave respawn purchase
description: Pay Ferox 5,000,000 GP to unlock this respawn option permanently. Selecting it as your current respawn is separate.

name: Civitas illa Fortis respawn
description: Earn 5,000 Glory for Challenger rank in the Colosseum to unlock this respawn option.

name: Varlamore prayer animation
description: Finish In Search of Knowledge, open the Crypt of the Moon, then speak to the Knight of Varlamore at Kourend Castle.

name: Free Droalak’s soul
description: Return to Droalak after Making History and finish the conversation that releases his soul.

name: Free Klenter’s soul
description: Return to Klenter after Icthlarin’s Little Helper to release his soul.

name: Hosidius house style
description: Buy Hosidius blueprints from Mahogany Homes and take them to an estate agent when changing your house style.

name: Free the Darkmeyer slave
description: Give the slave 100 Hallowed marks during the encounter to change their future dialogue.

name: Count Check reward
description: After setting up a bank PIN and a Jagex Account, ask Count Check to inspect your account and collect the lamp. Confirm this reward manually; no security settings are collected.

name: Enhanced gravestone
description: Pay Death 200,000 GP in Death’s Office for the cosmetic gravestone upgrade.

name: Knight of the Lion encounter
description: Find this spirit while looting coffins in the Hallowed Sepulchre. It can then appear in the lobby.
